objects.name: Progress security advisory (AV26-746)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-746 Date: July 24, 2026 On July 23, 2026, Progress published security advisories to address vulnerabilities in the following product: MOVEit Transfer – versions prior to 2025.1.5 MOVEit Transfer – versions prior to 2026.0.3 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply the necessary updates.
